title: Autonomous locality investigation of insulin electronic correlations
difficulty_reasons: The agent must generate and discriminate a finite but researcher-chosen space of fragment/overlap designs, justify coverage and stopping, and validate correlation conclusions without an author-route hint.

paper.title: Divide and correlate: mapping electronic correlations in proteins via local cut-wise reconstruction

data.description: Closed insulin system specification and deterministic PDB 3I40 retrieval instructions.

required_deliverables.description: Machine-readable candidate investigation, validation, conclusions and limitation report.
